body:
Why are those two `.gen.inc` a problem, and not the 68 `.compat.inc`, and the various other `.inc` files in the repo?
```
./core/math/bvh_structs.inc
./core/math/bvh_cull.inc
./core/math/bvh_split.inc
./core/math/color_names.inc
./core/math/bvh_public.inc
./core/math/bvh_integrity.inc
./core/math/bvh_pair.inc
./core/math/bvh_debug.inc
./core/math/bvh_logic.inc
./core/math/bvh_misc.inc
./core/math/bvh_refit.inc
./core/string/char_range.inc
./platform/web/dom_keys.inc
./editor/import/unicode_ranges.inc
./thirdparty/basis_universal/transcoder/basisu_transcoder_tables_astc.inc
./thirdparty/basis_universal/transcoder/basisu_transcoder_tables_astc_0_255.inc
./thirdparty/basis_universal/transcoder/basisu_transcoder_tables_atc_55.inc
./thirdparty/basis_universal/transcoder/basisu_transcoder_tables_atc_56.inc
./thirdparty/basis_universal/transcoder/basisu_transcoder_tables_bc7_m5_alpha.inc
./thirdparty/basis_universal/transcoder/basisu_transcoder_tables_bc7_m5_color.inc
./thirdparty/basis_universal/transcoder/basisu_transcoder_tables_pvrtc2_45.inc
./thirdparty/basis_universal/transcoder/basisu_transcoder_tables_pvrtc2_alpha_33.inc
./thirdparty/basis_universal/transcoder/basisu_transcoder_tables_dxt1_5.inc
./thirdparty/basis_universal/transcoder/basisu_transcoder_tables_dxt1_6.inc
```

It has to do with how those two are generated files. The compiler will still handle those `.inc` headers as expected, so already-existing includes won't cause builds to lapse. It's theoretically possible editing the contents of **just** an `.inc` file would not properly rebuild on ninja, but I can't say for certain
